description_en:
Creates an edge container application. You can deploy and release the application by version to containerize edge services.
Note: Activate the EdgeContainer service in the console before calling this operation. Calls from accounts that have not activated the service will return a service activation error
description_zh:
创建边缘容器的应用，通过应用的版本部署和发布完成边缘服务的容器化。
注意：调用前须已在控制台开通 EdgeContainer 服务；未开通账号的调用将返回服务激活相关错误
name: CreateEdgeContainerApp

parameters.help_en:
The application name. The name must start with a lowercase letter and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). The name must be 6 to 128 characters in length.
<notice>Activate the EdgeContainer service in the console before calling this operation. Calls from accounts that have not activated the service will return a service activation error.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用名称，必须小写字母打头，支持小写字母，数字，横杠。长度限制6~128字符。
<notice>调用前须已在控制台开通 EdgeContainer 服务；未开通账号的调用将返回服务激活相关错误。</notice>
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The server port number. Only 80 and 443 are accepted
parameters.help_zh: 服务端端口号，仅接受 80 和 443
parameters.name: service_port

parameters.help_en: The backend port, which is also the service port of the application. Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 后端端口，也是应用的服务端口，范围1~65535
parameters.name: target_port

parameters.help_en: The remarks. If this parameter is not specified, the value is empty by default
parameters.help_zh: 备注信息，不填写则默认为空
parameters.name: remarks

parameters.help_en:
The health check type, which includes Layer 4 and Layer 7 probing. If this parameter is not specified, the value is empty by default.

Valid values:

l4: Layer 4 probing.
l7: Layer 7 probing
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查类型，包括四层和七层探测，不填写默认为空。

取值：

l4：表示四层探测。
l7：表示七层探测
parameters.name: health_check_type

parameters.help_en: The domain name used for health checks. If this parameter is not specified, the value is empty by default
parameters.help_zh: 用于健康检查的域名， 不填写则默认为空
parameters.name: health_check_host

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP status code that indicates the health check is Normal. Valid values:

http_2xx (default).
http_3xx
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查正常时的HTTP状态码。取值：

http_2xx（默认值）。
http_3xx
parameters.name: health_check_http_code

parameters.help_en:
The health check method for HTTP-type listeners. Valid values:

HEAD (default): Requests only the headers of the page.
GET: Requests the specified page information and returns the entity body
parameters.help_zh:
监听HTTP类型健康检查的健康检查方法。取值：

HEAD（默认值）：只请求页面的首部。
GET：请求指定的页面信息，并返回实体主体
parameters.name: health_check_method

parameters.help_en:
The URI used for health checks.
The length is limited to 1 to 80 characters.
Default value: "/"
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的URI。
长度限制为1~80。
默认值："/"
parameters.name: health_check_uri

parameters.help_en:
The port used for health checks.
Valid values: 1 to 65535.
Default value: 80
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的端口。
取值范围：1~65535。
默认值: 80
parameters.name: health_check_port

parameters.help_en:
The amount of time to wait for a response from the health check. If the backend ECS instance does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check is considered failed.    

Valid values: 1 to 100.   
Default value: 3.
Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
接收来自运行状况检查的响应需要等待的时间。如果后端ECS在指定的时间内没有正确响应，则判定为健康检查失败。    

取值：1~100。   
默认值：3。
单位：秒
parameters.name: health_check_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The interval between health checks.
Valid values: 1 to 50.
Default value: 5.
Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。
取值：1~50。
默认值：5。
单位：秒
parameters.name: health_check_interval

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks required. If an application is unhealthy, it is considered healthy again after the specified number of consecutive successful probes.
Valid values: 1 to 10.
Default value: 2
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续成功次数。如果应用不健康，经过多少次连续探测后都是成功返回，则认为应用恢复健康状态。
取值：1~10。
默认值：2
parameters.name: health_check_succ_times

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks required. If an application is healthy, it is considered unhealthy after the specified number of consecutive failed probes.
Valid values: 1 to 10. 
Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续失败次数。如果应用健康，经过多少次连续探测后都是失败返回，则认为应用为不健康状态。
取值：1~10， 
默认：5
parameters.name: health_check_fail_times

AppId.description_en: The ID of the created application
